title: Three drivers facing grid penalties for F1's Malaysia return
paragraphs: So far, three Formula 1 drivers will have to serve grid penalties at this weekend's Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia. Racing Bulls driver Arvid Lindblad will start at the back of the grid as his team fits new power unit components. Racing Bulls announced on Thursday at Sepang that Lindblad would take multiple fresh power unit components that will trigger a back-of-the-grid penalty.
